assumptions.choice: Main trading session rule omitted as non-restricting
assumptions.reason: The execution environment uses a daily (1D) data feed representing main trading session bars, so session timing constraints (09:30-16:00 ET) are inherently met.
No external economic calendar data feed is available in the single OHLCV execution environment.

assumptions.choice: Consolidation evaluated over prior 10 bars (bars -10 to -1)
assumptions.reason: The consolidation range upper/lower boundaries must be defined prior to the breakout candle (bar 0) for the current close to exceed or break below those boundaries.

assumptions.choice: Position size = (portfolio_value * 0.01) / close_price using exact share sizing
assumptions.reason: The specification requires position size to be 1% of total trading capital.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit and stop-loss checked against bar High/Low in next()
assumptions.reason: Reaching a 5% TP or 2% SL target within the bar is accurately detected using High and Low prices relative to the executed entry price.
